description:
Create interactive presentations for free with Menti. Whether you’re presenting online or in-person, Menti helps you engage your audience using real-time polls, live quizzes, Q&As and word clouds.

Ask participants to join your Menti from their phone or laptop, and they can answer questions and share insights together in the moment.

Turn an idea for your next meeting into a Menti in seconds. Suitable for all types of live speaking, from town halls and presentations to workshops, lectures and classes. Simply describe what you want to ask your audience, and Menti will build the perfect slide. Edit and reorder as much as you like, then decide whether to make the answers public so everyone can see, or keep them private to reduce bias. Time to turn your presentations into conversations with Menti by Mentimeter!

defaultPrompt: Create a poll to understand how clear the new company vision is to employees, and what questions there are for leadership team
Shorten "Q3 Team Kickoff" to five questions and add a quick word cloud icebreaker.
